title: Projections comparator tests
description: Tests for a custom comparator, in the file beside its comparator file (`X.comparator.test.yaml` for `X.comparator.yaml`), never part of the comparator or its digest. Each case gives two extractions and states what the comparator must make of them: partial expectations (step order, steps, changes, counts, metadata, or the error the comparator must fail with) and an optional snapshot of the whole comparison. `projections check` runs them. See docs/contracts.md, "Comparator tests".

$schema.description: Editors: `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` at the top of the file works too.

options.description: Comparator options for every case without its own; without either, a projection's own options.

id.description: A change ID, or an item ID naming the changes whose `before` or `after` includes it.

name.description: Unique within the file: the case's ID.

options.description: Comparator options for this case, replacing the file's.

snapshot.description: A JSON file, relative to the test file, holding the whole comparison (sorted keys, two-space indentation). `projections check --update` writes it.

source.description: An extraction: a fixture file (an extraction, or a saved `projections.extraction` document) relative to the test file, written inline, or the projection extracted at a revision (`working-tree` for the working tree) with the working tree's definition.

oneOf.description: A path relative to the test file, inside the repository.

file.description: A path relative to the test file, inside the repository.

order.description: Each listed change or item is in a strictly earlier step than the next.

steps.description: Every step, in order; each lists only what it checks.

changes.description: Changes or items naming exactly the step's changes.
Each selects exactly one change, by `item` or `id`, and checks the fields it lists.

item.description: Selects the change whose `before` or `after` includes this item ID.

id.description: Selects the change with this ID.

metadata.description: A subset of the comparison metadata: objects match on the keys they list, arrays and scalars exactly.

error.description: The comparator must fail with a message containing this text. A case expecting an error checks nothing else.
